clips.title: The story
paras: Dockmaster Baren pays travelers to bring in spotted sunfish from Lake Everstill. The fish are a Lakeshire staple, but murlocs along the shore make them dangerous to gather.

Spotted sunfish are a delicate catch prized across the lands around Lake Everstill. Townspeople and passing merchants keep demand high, yet Lakeshire's supplies often run thin despite the fish below the surface. Local threats stretch the town's strength, so even trade in basic goods depends on travelers.

Anglers nearby could usually meet Dockmaster Baren's orders with ease. Now aggressive murloc tribes haunt the shallows and banks, keeping ordinary townsfolk from the water. You can fish while watching for danger, or take sunfish from the foraging murlocs that trouble the shore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish. There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!
Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them. If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have some sunfish for me, eh?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
